reading: This is a full product-detail page design: a site header bar, a breadcrumb trail, a vertical thumbnail gallery, a large hero product image with a garment silhouette, product title/rating/price, colour and size selectors, add-to-bag and wishlist buttons, a free-delivery note, and three expandable detail accordions (Details, Care & materials, Returns).
